title: Westwood Park – Ohio Avenue Safety and Mobility Project – Grant of Right to
text:
Westwood Park – Ohio Avenue Safety and Mobility Project – Grant of Right to
  the City of Los Angeles Department of Public Works for a Portion of the
  Northwest Corner of Ohio Avenue and Sepulveda Boulevard for Right of Way
  Purposes – Categorical Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA) Pursuant Article 19, Section 15301 [Operation, Repair, Maintenance,
  Permitting, Leasing, Licensing, or Minor Alteration of Existing Public or Private
  Structures, Facilities, Mechanical Equipment, or Topographical Features,
  Involving Negligible or No Expansion of Existing or Former Use] of California
  CEQA Guidelines and Article III, Section 1, Class 1(14) of City CEQA Guidelines
